correctness.rationale: The exact Green solution \(w(t)=G_q(y(t))\int_{t_*}^{t}\varepsilon(s)\,\mathrm ds\) gives the operator norm. The left-side root-gap has derivative \(y^{1-q}/[(1-y)(q-1-qy)^2]>0\), with endpoint limits \(-\infty\) and \(+\infty\), hence a unique left maximum. The right branch is bounded by \(\log(q/(q-1))<1/(q-1)<B_q\). Under the scaled coordinate \(z=q(1-y)\), the root equation has a strictly decreasing limiting function with one zero, proving \(qB_q\to z_*/(z_*-1)\). The standard-library checker reproduced 3,139 supplementary checks. The unweighted comparison is a proven lower-bound asymptotic only.

value.rationale: The motivating source explicitly identifies residual forcing as a remaining continuous-conditioning caveat after front pinning. This result quantifies a natural velocity-relative residual norm by the exact best possible gain, locates the unique worst-response state before the front, and yields a universal large-reaction-order limit. It is a motivated structural benchmark for spatially varying residual tolerance analysis, not an unconditional numerical residual certificate; near-equilibrium weights can be very small.
